readingReview.comparison: The first reader's order matches the script exactly. Their concerns: (1) The nurse is unintroduced. Her lavender scrubs, lanyard and the vitals equipment establish her role, and the source calls her only 'Nurse'. Acceptable. (2) 'Just relax your arm' comes after the cuff is on. The moment is just before she squeezes the bulb, so the line is natural, and it is the user-approved r13 wording. Acceptable. (3) The 'RAVI · READY' box extends onto the bezel and looks pasted on. Confirmed: its lower edge passes the screen by about 19 px. It sits on the drawn notification card under the check icon, is legible, and hides nothing. This is a minor style point, not a defect. (4) 'NOW · A-12' links back to page 03, as intended. Nothing is unresolved.
